description: This file defines the EntityClause class used for constructing conditional clauses involving entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages entities, fields, and operations to help build query conditions in the ORM layer.

classes.name: EntityClause
classes.description: Represents a clause involving one or two entities, specifying the entities, fields, and operations for query construction.

methods.name: getFirstEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the first entity involved in the clause.

methods.name: getSecondEntity
methods.description: Returns the name of the second entity involved in the clause, if any.

methods.name: getFirstField
methods.description: Returns the first field name used in the clause.

methods.name: getSecondField
methods.description: Returns the second field name used in the clause.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the clause, initializing it if null.

methods.name: getInterFieldOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation used between fields of different entities.

methods.name: getIntraFieldOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation used within the same entity's fields.

methods.name: setFirstEntity
methods.description: Sets the name of the first entity.

methods.name: setSecondEntity
methods.description: Sets the name of the second entity.

methods.name: setInterFieldOperation
methods.description: Sets the operation between fields of different entities.

methods.name: setIntraFieldOperation
methods.description: Sets the operation within the same entity field.

methods.name: setModelEntities
methods.description: Initializes ModelEntity objects for the involved entities using a ModelReader.

methods.name: getFirstModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity object for the first entity.

methods.name: getSecondModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity object for the second entity.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityClause, including all properties.
